intro: The Rose Chair is your sturdy yet inviting companion. Its smooth, cushioned PU seat ensures comfort, while the solid wood frame brings warmth and ease to every meal, making you feel truly welcome.

features.title: Built to last
features.text: Our solid wood construction ensures strength and durability that lasts for years.

features.title: Easy to clean finish
features.text: PU-coated wood resists wear and makes cleaning simple, so your dining area always looks fresh.

features.title: Comfortable cushioned seat
features.text: Sink into comfort with the soft PU-upholstered seat—durable, easy to clean, and perfect for everyday living.

features.title: Designed for your comfort
features.text: Stay comfortable through long meals—ergonomic high-back support keeps you at ease while adding a stylish touch.

features.title: A timeless addition
features.text: Classic design meets modern comfort—so you feel right at home, wherever you place this chair.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
